inputs.history: the vault's own on-chain decision events before this decision
inputs.price: close of the last closed daily candle (Binance NEARUSDT 1d); the spot reference price is recorded but not read

rule: Enter on a close above the prior 55-day high and keep buying toward all NEAR until a close below the prior 20-day low; then keep selling toward all USDC until the next entry. In or out is the side of the vault's last on-chain trade request.
